arm: A2: sherpa-onnx v1.13.8 + QNN (HTP), parakeet-ctc-0.6b SM8850 context binary, 30 s window

zip.note: public download, no login; Qualcomm publishes no digest

qairt.license_note: Qualcomm's license: the libraries ship only inside an application; used here for the measurement, never committed or published

model.name: sherpa-onnx-qnn-SM8850-binary-parakeet-ctc-0.6b-30s
model.readme: none in the tar (info.txt, tokens.txt, model.bin, test_wavs/)

qnn_sdk_of_the_context_binary.release_body: Context binary files in this page are generated using qnn sdk 2.40.0.251030

export_recipe.workflow: k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx .github/workflows/export-parakeet-ctc-qnn.yaml at 9961aee6 (2026-06-18, 'Export Parakeet CTC models to QNN (#3686)'; the release assets are dated 2026-06-17, the PR's runs)
export_recipe.num_frames: num_seconds * 100 = 3000 for 30 s; model input x [1, frames, 80] (sherpa's QNN impl reads it from the graph)
export_recipe.converter: qnn-onnx-converter --input_list <calibration raws> --use_native_input_files --act_bitwidth 16 --bias_bitwidth 32 (weights_bitwidth default 8: QAIRT 2.40 converter source) = post-training quantized, int8 weights, 16-bit activations
export_recipe.context_config: scripts/qnn/generate_config.py: SM8850 soc_id 87, dsp_arch v81, vtcm_mb 8, O 3, perf_profile burst (for qnn-context-binary-generator)

build.command: SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_QNN=ON SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_BINARY=ON SHERPA_ONNX_ANDROID_PLATFORM=android-24 CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 QNN_SDK_ROOT=<qairt> ANDROID_NDK=<ndk> ./build-android-arm64-v8a.sh (tools/asr-qnn/build.sh)
build.android_platform_why: the script's default android-21 does not link the executables with NDK 28: libonnxruntime.so 1.28.2 needs API 23-24 libc symbols (__write_chk@LIBC_N ...), lld refuses them for an executable
build.stl: c++_static (the toolchain default; the executables need no libc++_shared.so)

bin.how: compiled with sherpa-onnx-offline's compile rule, linked with its link.txt (object swapped), stripped

version_strings: ORT Build Info: git-branch=HEAD, git-commit-id=33ca962, fp8-kv-cache=1, build type=Release
onnxruntime.note: the model graph runs on the HTP through the QNN API (sherpa-onnx/csrc/qnn), not through onnxruntime
